note: Questions whose LoCoMo gold contradicts the transcript, or that need the image. Found while hand-reading 148 read failures of one run, so this list is incomplete (an estimated 16-24 more exist among unread wrong answers). Report accuracy with and without these. No corpus text is stored here. 2026-10-10: added tag evidence_label_error (gold answer is right but a labelled evidence turn does not support it; correct turn id in the reason), from B2_EVIDENCE_AUDIT.md. 2026-10-10 (R2-5): four more evidence_label_error entries from the stable-failure review (0-70, 1-43, 0-151, 1-48); none changes the with/without-errata accuracy, which drops only gold_error and needs_image. 2026-10-10 (I62): five new entries of three new classes. premise_error (question premise contradicts the transcript, gold still right), bad_evidence_id (malformed evidence id, QA unaffected), cat5_answerable (a cat-5 question the transcript answers, abstention gold wrong). Reviewed and rejected: 1-63 (question says May 23, the acceptance is mentioned on 27 May as 'just got accepted'; the transcript does not date the acceptance, so nothing is contradicted). None of the new tags is excluded by default (DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_TAGS is unchanged); `forensics_report.py --errata-extended` also drops premise_error and cat5_answerable (non-borderline), reported as a second column.
